meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 你问某条 senpi 提示(Tip)是什么意思时,Claude 会先查看系统里的提示清单,再核对你在当前设置下实际能看到哪些提示,最后对照源码,用你提问的语言解释这条提示背后的具体机制。
howto.when: 当你说出“give-me-tips”,或询问某条 Tip: 的含义、如何运作,或问自己能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 解释一下启动时那条“失败会自动重试”的提示,具体怎么运作?
say.note: Claude 会先查提示列表,再读相关源码解释机制。

say.text: 按我的设置,我现在能看到哪些提示?挑一条详细讲讲。
Fable 5 拒绝后出现的那条 Tip,背后是什么流程?
say.note: Claude 会查相关组件源码,解释这条提示为何会出现。

howto.what_en: If you ask what a senpi tip means, Claude fetches the live tip list, verifies which tips are visible for you, reads the real source, and explains the mechanism in your language.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "give-me-tips", ask what a Tip: line means or how it works, or ask which tips you can see.

say_en.text: How does the startup tip about retrying on failure actually work?
say_en.note: Claude lists live tips and digs into the source.

say_en.text: Which tips can I see with my current settings? Pick one and explain it.
say_en.note: Claude reads your settings and shows only what you can see.

say_en.text: What's behind the Fable 5 refusal tip?
say_en.note: Claude traces the fallback-architect pipeline in source.
